question: On selling an item for Rs. 1,500, a shopkeeper loses 20%. For what amount should he sell it to gain 10%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of the item = Rs. 1,500

Loss = 20%

Desired gain = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) = Selling Price / (1 - Loss%)
